title: Strengthen the Hito 4 economic gate: emit microgame-payout CoinDeltas + per-seed ledger-reconciliation assertion
description: Filed from the TASK-042 review (rev-t042 MEDIUM M1 + M2). The Hito 4 1000-session economic-invariant gate (Hito4GateTests.cs) is genuine and non-vacuous for the board/weapon/evento/wager economy, but two rigor gaps remain: M1 — the gate deliberately runs a NeverFinishingMicrogame fake to avoid the real microgame-PAYOUT path, because PayoutRules.ApplyCompetitive/ApplyCoop (PayoutRules.cs:46,60) do a direct coins[seat]+= with NO CoinDelta emitted (a pre-existing TASK-051/052 characteristic). So the sweep's 'zero economic-invariant violations' covers board/weapon/evento/wager flows but NOT microgame payouts. Payouts are income (they only ADD coins, sourced from the visible Bank), so they don't violate §5.3's hard 'coins taken must not vanish' invariant — but the missing CoinDelta is a 'flujo = espectáculo' (§5.3) presentation gap and leaves the payout economy outside the milestone gate. WORK M1: make PayoutRules emit origin(Bank)->destination(seat) CoinDeltas for every payout, then remove the NeverFinishingMicrogame workaround so the gate drives REAL payouts across all 1000 sessions and folds them into the conservation check. M2 — CheckRoundInvariant (Hito4GateTests.cs:169-177) fires at every BOARD_RESOLVE exit with fsm.BoardSnapshot available but only checks CoinDelta.Amount>0; add the strongest §5.3 check — assert Coins == BoardSnapshot.Balances at every resolve across all 1000 seeds (today that reconciliation is only in 3 pre-existing fast tests over one session). Read PayoutRules + the TASK-042 Hito4GateTests + the TASK-068 reconciliation code. Core/engine-free, fast+slow testable.
acceptance_criteria: PayoutRules emits a visible origin(Bank)->destination(seat) CoinDelta for every competitive/coop payout, satisfying §5.3 'flujo = espectáculo'; no coins created without a delta
The Hito 4 1000-session sweep drives REAL microgame payouts (NeverFinishingMicrogame workaround removed) and folds payout flows into the zero-economic-invariant-violation check
The 1000-session sweep asserts Coins == BoardSnapshot.Balances at every BOARD_RESOLVE exit (per-seed reconciliation, not just delta positivity)
Fast + slow suites green, no regression; the strengthened gate still passes with zero violations (or surfaces a real one)

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body:
CLOSED (loop iter 6) — tdd, depth FULL. All 4 ACs met; fresh-context review rev-t071 APPROVE-WITH-NITS (no HIGH); orchestrator gates independently fast 848/0 + slow 11/0 (1000-session sweep with REAL payouts, zero violations).

DELIVERY: strengthened the Hito 4 economic gate (rev-t042 M1+M2). Commits: 04b614b (tests, genuine red CS0029/CS1061) / 7feba60 (feat M1: PayoutRules emits Bank-origin CoinDeltas + SessionStateMachine.LastMicrogamePayout seam) / 46dc071 (test M2: gate drives real payouts + per-resolve reconciliation) / 55ca759 (fix-round M1/L1 anti-vacuity counters). Fast 842->848 (+6), slow 11/11.

M1 (payout CoinDeltas): PayoutRules.ApplyCompetitive/ApplyCoop now RETURN CoinDelta[] (Bank->seat, one per paid seat) alongside the still-performed direct coins[seat]+= mutation. rev-t071 verified conservation firsthand: delta = new CoinDelta(Bank, seat, +amount), NEVER seat->seat; report-only (LastMicrogamePayout read solely by the gate, never replayed through ApplyCoinFlows) so no double-count, no §5.3 break; signature void->CoinDelta[] source-compatible across all ~15 callers (only the 2 real callers in CaptureResult capture it, rest are bare statements/comments); no seat silently stops being paid.

M2 (real payouts + reconciliation): NeverFinishingMicrogame workaround REMOVED, replaced with a real EsquivaMicrogame (DurationSeconds:2f clears the 4s MgPlay ceiling; RoundPhaseMachine.Play is purely time-bounded, verified). The 1000-session sweep now drives REAL microgame payouts folded into the zero-violation check (CheckMicrogamePayoutInvariant: every delta>0, origin==Bank at the MgResult edge). CheckRoundInvariant now asserts Coins==BoardSnapshot.Balances seat-by-seat at EVERY resolve across all 1000 seeds. Both mutation-proven: commenting out SetBalances fails reconciliation; swapping payout origin/dest fails the Bank-origin check. LastMicrogamePayout reset per round (top of CaptureResult, mirrors LastResult) + proven by LastMicrogamePayout_ClimaxRound_IsEmpty.

FIX ROUND (55ca759, slow-test only — rev-t071 M1+L1, the anti-vacuity hardening this gate-rigor ticket most needed): the gate now COUNTS observations, not just failures — payoutObservedCount and reconciliationRunCount both asserted Is.EqualTo(7000) (derived exactly = 1000 sessions x 7 regular rounds; climax has no board sub-loop / never reaches MgResult), not a bare >0. A real sweep confirmed 7000/7000 exact — so the gate now PROVES real payouts + real reconciliations genuinely occurred across the sweep, closing the 'zero violations among zero payouts' vacuity the ticket exists to prevent. Also empirically confirms IdleTimeout (45s) never fires in the bot-driven gate (no round's payout silently zeroed by idle exclusion).

[ASSUMED] (reviewer-confirmed correct): Esquiva chosen as the gate microgame (input-independent duration-ceiling finish, least fragile for a zero-input bot sweep); DurationSeconds:2f harness value; the 'fold' interpretation (payout deltas into the violation-count list via positivity+Bank-origin, NOT into Coins==Balances — correct because payouts don't touch board Balances until the next EnterBoardMove resync, which precedes the resolve check; no coins escape a check). No new GDD gaps.

NOTE: TASK-078 (coop phase) + TASK-041 epic remain blocked on HIGH-1. Next: TASK-074 (last independent goal ticket).
